title: Fake customer care: screen shared and remote app open during a refund call
story: Searching for a courier helpline, she called a number from a search ad. The 'agent' had her install a screen-sharing app 'to process the refund' and is now guiding her to pay ₹25,000.
why: Screen sharing and a remote-access app during a call from an unknown number, paying 32× her usual amount to a new account. Screen sharing during a payment is close to a scam by itself.
